title: Website Marketing Audit
description: Marketing setup of websites: pixels, analytics, CMS, chat, contacts, SEO basics and a score.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Websites to audit: example.com or full links. One home page is checked per site.

datasetId.title: Dataset of businesses (Google Maps Scraper)
datasetId.description: ID of a dataset in your account, for example the results of the Google Maps Scraper. Each business's website is audited, and its name, category, phone, rating and reviews are carried over. Other datasets with a website or url field work too.

includeNoWebsite.title: Include businesses without a website
includeNoWebsite.description: From the dataset, also save businesses with no website or only a Facebook or other social page: often the best leads for a web or ads agency.

maxMarketingScore.title: Save only sites scoring at most
maxMarketingScore.description: Keep only weaker setups, for example 60 for businesses with clear gaps. Sites above it are left out (free). Empty saves all.

checkContactPage.title: Check the contact page
checkContactPage.description: When the home page has no email, also read the site's contact or about page for emails, phones, chat buttons and social links.

maxSites.title: Maximum sites
maxSites.description: Stop after this many websites and businesses.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Websites are opened directly. Turn on a proxy only if you need requests to come from another country.
